objs.name: document
objs.description: Central artifact in policies, guidelines and documents management; participates in creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving workflows.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of document; selected when creating a new object.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: References to other documents or external references.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Associated IT applications as master data.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Companies relevant to the document's scope or validity.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational areas where the document is valid.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Document attachment that is linked to a document; can be released together with the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information attached to a document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Equipment or equipment-related information attached to a document; subject to its own versioning.
